answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so the memory_b1 playbook cannot be used. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail requests and would drop customer writes, which violates the primary objective. Write-path p99 at 5x during peak settlement writes is most consistent with saturation; memory_b3 is the closest match (headroom kept write queues healthy). Read-replica routing (memory_b5) recovered write latency only after offloading dashboard/report reads, which are not in evidence here, and would not absorb heavy writes. Regional failover during peak settlement writes risks disrupting in-flight writes. Adding capacity is the one intervention that can restore write-path availability without discarding customer writes. Uncertainty remains: the 2-hour-old release may be the true cause, and memory_b3 describes provisioning before a peak rather than mid-incident scale-out—hence verifying b3 and not treating root cause as known.
